description: Compute the current per-candidate tally for a simulation+level. For President: state-aggregated EVs. For others: feature counts. For level:"senate" the default is the 50-state per-candidate race scoreboard; pass…

chamber.description: level:"senate" only — return real chamber control ({D,R,I,seats_up,held_over,majority_status}) via the same math as senate_control, instead of the 50-state race scoreboard.

cycle.description: Election cycle for chamber control (level:"senate", chamber:true); default 2028. Ignored otherwise.

workspace_scope.description: Optional workspace for THIS call: use an exact personal/team ID from list_workspaces. Repeat on each call; it does not change the connection default. Must agree with MCP metadata and the effective HTTP workspace selector (header, otherwise connector URL). OAuth connections can only use their granted workspace. Membership and campaign permissions still apply.

name: get_tally
